design_philosophy: Modern Indian fintech-meets-Bharat. Trustworthy, professional, and confident. Heavy reliance on structural clarity, solid colors, and strong typographic hierarchy instead of generic SaaS gradients or cliche ethnic motifs.

primary_saffron.usage: Primary action triggers, CTA buttons, active states, progress indicators. Used sparingly for high emotional energy.

secondary_indigo.usage: Trust elements, headers, primary typography emphasis, trust badges, structure.

background_base.usage: Main application background. Warm off-white to feel approachable but professional.

surface_cards.usage: Widgets, strategy bento grids, and marketplace cards.

text_primary.usage: Headlines and body copy. Tinted deep gray.

borders.usage: Subtle structure lines for bento grids and strategy layout.

headings.usage: All H1-H4. Expressive, wide, authoritative. (Load Cabinet Grotesk via Fontshare CDN, fallback to Outfit).

body.usage: All paragraph text, form labels, small text. (Load via Google Fonts).

marketing_page.layout: Custom HTML/Tailwind, Mode A (Tetris Grid) for features.
marketing_page.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Massive Cabinet Grotesk typography. Left align text, overlapping rural images on the right.
marketing_page.components: Do not use Shadcn for layout. Use pure HTML. High padding (p-12 to p-24).

strategy_showcase.layout: Sidebar navigation + Content Area. Mode B (Control Room Grid).
strategy_showcase.sidebar: Sticky sidebar on desktop, sticky top nav on mobile. Active states indicated by #3F37C9 border-left.
strategy_showcase.content: Bento-style grids for the 10 sections. 'Grid Borders' surface strategy: visible 1px borders (border-gray-200) to expose structure.

marketplace_mvp.components: Use heavily customized Shadcn components (Cards, Tables, Forms). Remove shadow from cards, use flat 1px borders instead.
marketplace_mvp.map: Leaflet map integration. Use grayscale or muted map tiles to prevent color clashing. Map pins should be #FF6B35.
marketplace_mvp.trust_badges: Tier 1/2/3 verified badges. Solid #3F37C9 background with white Lucide React icons.

interactions.hover_states: Always explicit. Button hover: hover:bg-[#3F37C9]/90 for indigo, hover:bg-[#FF6B35]/90 for saffron.
interactions.animations: Micro-interactions for trust elements. Staggered fade-ins for marketplace list items. No heavy 3D or parallax.

tech_stack.components: shadcn/ui (only for Dashboard/Marketplace forms and functional elements)

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='job-post-submit', data-testid='worker-profile-card').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Saffron/Indigo meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.

hero_backgrounds.description: Serene Indian village landscape, use for marketing hero or waitlist section.

workers_and_farmers.description: Worker on scaffolding. Use for worker profile mockups or 'Masons' category card.
Farmer with smartphone in wheat field. Ideal for 'Customers' or 'How it works' section.
Close-up of Indian man at market. Use for testimonial avatar.
Mason building a wall. Use for 'Job details' or worker discovery map preview.

instructions_to_main_agent: NEVER use placeholder text for images. Only use the URLs provided in image_urls.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Explicitly load and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Fontshare) or 'Outfit' (Google Fonts) for headings and 'Manrope' for body copy.
Apply data-testid to every interactive element without exception.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards on the marketing landing page. Build custom overlapping layouts using raw Tailwind.
Strategy page must feature a sticky sidebar and bento-box style grids to make text-heavy content digestible.
Implement simulated WhatsApp bot chat using a flat container with Saffron and Indigo speech bubbles.
Render the Leaflet map with grayscale tiles (e.g., CartoDB Positron) so that #FF6B35 markers pop out visually.
